metaTitle: Custom Fleece Stadium Blankets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom fleece stadium blankets for your next event. Soft, warm, and perfect for branding. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Fleece stadium blankets offer the warmth and softness fans want at outdoor games, tailgates, and corporate events. Unlike woven throws, fleece resists pilling and holds vibrant screen-printed logos or embroidered names without fraying. Choose from roll-up styles for easy giveaway packing or plaid fleece for a classic look. These blankets keep your brand visible and cozy from the first chill of fall through spring playoffs.
